profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at General Dynamics Electric Boat
profile.summary: Embedded software engineer at GDEB with a bachelors in Computer Science and Engineering from UConn.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Built a Python-based graphical user interface within a Scrum framework to automate SQL script generation for financial institutions, reducing manual effort and turnaround time 
Refactored COCC’s INSIGHT ATM middleware in C# into a standalone service, improving maintainability 
and scalability 
Developed SQL scripts for financial institutions in a waterfall SDLC environment, ensuring accuracy and 
compliance with business requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Implemented automated serialization across multiple product lines by integrating Agile PLM with Zebra 
printers, improving traceability and efficiency in managing assemblies and subassemblies 
Refactored assembly numbers in Agile PLM on a compressed timeline, ensuring on-time startup of 
production at an additional Hologic manufacturing floor 
Conducted root cause analysis to determine and eliminate sources of product defects
positions.insights: Process Automation, Software Development and +5 skills

positions.locationName: Storrs Mansfield, Connecticut, United States · On-site

positions.title: Information Technology Service Management Specialist
positions.description:
Assisted clients with software and hardware troubleshooting issues on campus
Diagnosed and resolved issues with classroom computers, projectors, and dedicated servers 
Collaborated with a support team using Jira ticketing to track and resolve technical issues
positions.insights: Customer Service, Information Technology Infrastructure and +10 skills
